messages.subject: incorrect case
parts:
Hello dear all, I am trying to perform some line transect analysis but I am having some trouble with my files and I can't figure out a way to solve it. I 've performed a distance sampling surveys in two different areas of a reserve (loro and zaino) most of the transects are 10 km long except for two of them which are shorter. I tried to estimate density using the simplest model and assigning each area of the reserve one region.Label, but I got this error: 

 flatfile column names detected but with incorrect cAsE, correct the names and re-run. See ?flatfile for details.

When I have a look at ?flatfile I learned that different areas should be considered different cases, so I 've tried to consider a case for each transect and I 've named them differently. But I still have the same error. 

Any suggestions?
Regards
Antonela

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] incorrect case
parts:
Antonela

The 'ds()` function in the Distance package is very specific about capitalisation of field names in your input data.  Consulting the documentation for flatfile as you did, you will note that the first letter of each part of field names are to be capitalised (e.g., Sample.Label) with the exception of the field containing the perpendicular (line transects) or radial distances (point transects) (distance).

In your email you have the following:
assigning each area of the reserve one region.Label, but I got this error

Rather than "region.Label", you should name this field "Region.Label".  See if that removes the error.
